shortDescription: Psycasts² — Diablo 2-style psycast skill levels, auto synergies, a PoE constellation spec tree, seven ascension constellations, meditation→awakening→3-tier enlightenment, enemy psycaster tiers, two pilgrimage quest chains, an open-beta balance-feedback JSON export, a full XML trigger API for awakening (7 surfaces), a mod-facing TieringOverrideDef, full keyed localization (~480 keys), and celebration FX for level-ups, skill mastery, mastered trees, and spec commits.
body:
(spec excerpt - flat level cap, ISEKAI compat, psylink gate + random-Awakened spawn)

## Testing preference (standing)
ALWAYS launch with companion Modern Psycasts UI (`astryl.ModernPsycastsUI`). For FULL addon coverage also load every installed 1.6 VPE addon: dev.tobot.vpe.betterautocast, Aranmaho.Makai.Psycast, Waffle.FantasyPatches, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Hemosage, Danzen.VPE.BiotechIntegration, Aranmaho.RavenousEye.Wildhunter.Psycast, VPE.Horaxian.Sentinel, Aranmaho.RangerClass, mute.vpesensitivity, VPE.Aeromancer.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAeromancer, VPE.Anima.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAnima, VPE.Arknights.Sentinel, VPE.Blader.Sentinel, VPE.Bugmancer.Sentinel, VPE.Framework.Sentinel, VPE.Deadlife.Sentinel, VPE.Geomancer.Sentinel, VPE.Gravcaster.Sentinel, VPE.Hydromancer.Sentinel, VPE.Luminis.Sentinel, VPE.Mechanitor.Sentinel, VPE.Neurophage.Sentinel, VPE.Oripathy.Sentinel, VPE.PhaseShift.Sentinel, VPE.Umbra.Sentinel, VPE.Veincaster.Sentinel, VPE.Voidweaver.Sentinel, morton.VPEAddOnPsycastCardRetextures, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Puppeteer. EXCLUDED: VPE.Gauranlen.Sentinel (declares missing dep vanillaexpanded.ideo.dryads -> spams VDE_AwakenedDryad PawnKindDef + dryad texture errors; re-add only if the Dryads mod gets installed), VPE.BiotechIntegration.Adendum (missing dep), gwibbo.morepsygenes + Sl4vP0weR.NoPsycasts (not 1.6), VPersonaWeaponsE (not a psycast addon). Palette pins (tools take "T: " prefix; category is NOT a path segment): "Actions\T: Force awakening (Tier I)", "Actions\T: Grant psycaster level (+1)", "Actions\T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)" (mastery/tree-glow verification); incidents pin as "Actions\Do incident\PS_Awakening" / "Actions\Do incident\PS_AwakeningSurgeIncident". Known-unrelated noise: VPE .dds Texture2D load errors (e.g. PathBG_Archon.dds); stale palette pins from other sessions. cs-assets.json drift warnings for UI/Specs/* etc. are concatenation false positives; keep them. NOTE: isolated test sessions keep their OWN mod-settings config (test-savedata/Config/Mod_*.xml) — in-game tuning edits live there, but the Bake button writes ManualBalance.json into the mod folder itself, which persists.

## Celebration FX for level-ups, mastery, mastered trees, and spec commits (SkillFx.cs, 2026-07-10)
Modeled on the Window_Awakening card-reveal burst (glow flash + expanding ring + golden-ratio spark spray; reuses UI/Sparkle + UI/Glow + UI/Specs/node_ring). Static registry keyed by pawn+ability ("id:defName") or pawn+spec ("spec:id:specId"); draw sites poll SkillFx.Draw(rect, key) per repaint; bursts self-remove; Trigger sweeps entries older than 5s. Spark sizes scale with rect (clamped 0.4-1.3).
**Grades:** Invest (0.55s, 10 sparks, 1 box ring, level-chip cyan) on EVERY player level invest; Mastery (1.4s, 26 sparks, 2 staggered box rings, glow overshoot 2.1x, lingering pulsing gold border, at-cap gold) when the invest reaches the ABSOLUTE cap = maxSkillLevel + SpecEffects.LevelCapBonus (10/15) — NOT the psy-gated interim cap; SpecNode (0.6s, tree-line blue) per committed spec node; SpecCapstone (1.25s, card-gold, grandiose) for Specs.IsCapstone ids. **ROUND grades (SpecNode/SpecCapstone): constellation bursts draw NO rectangular boxes** — shockwave + capstone linger use the node_ring texture (circular); square ability icons keep box rings + border linger.
**NO BOXES IN THE CONSTELLATION, EVER (user directive, 2026-07-10 regression report):** DrawNode's PERSISTENT capstone frame is now a layered gold RING halo (NodeRingTex at ExpandedBy(3)+(7), owned/unowned alpha) — the old Widgets.DrawBox layered frame is gone. (The staged accent box and cost chips remain — small UI cues, not node frames.)
**Mastered trees (Patch_TreeMastered.cs):** a tree card whose EVERY path ability is learned AND at the absolute cap gets a persistent pulsing gold card glow + 7 ambient looping sparkle flecks (deterministic per tree defName, ~2.8s cycle, slow rise). SkillFx.TreeMastered(pawn, comp, path) cached per (pawn,path) per frame. **Hook is ONE postfix on PsycastsUIUtility.DoPathAbilities(artRect, path, ...)** — the shared render path BOTH VPE's native tab and Modern UI's DrawTreeTile call for unlocked trees (mastered ⇒ unlocked, so coverage is total; also inherits Window_BalanceEditor's preview, dev-only, harmless). The earlier two-patch approach (DrawPathBackground + soft DrawTreeTile) was REPLACED by this single hook. Pawn/comp from PsycastsUIUtility.Hediff/.CompAbilities.
**Verification dev tool:** "T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)" (MeditationSystem.cs debug action) sets every learned psycast to absCap via gc.SetLevel — state-only, no bursts (bursts are player-path FX), makes the tree glow testable in one click (reaching 15 legitimately needs psycaster level ~133 via the triangular ramp, unreachable in a quick session — this was why the glow "didn't show" in run #10).
**Hook sites (bursts):** Patch_DrawAbility (shift-click) + Dialog_ConfirmInvest (OK) route through SkillFx.OnSkillInvest(pawn, ability, newLvl) — replaces old Tick_High; burst draws over the ability icon in the owned-Repaint block. Window_Specializations.Apply triggers per pending id BEFORE pending.Clear; bursts drawn after the DrawNode loop inside the clip group, guarded by SkillFx.AnyActive; majorDone (any IsCapstone) => SkillFx.MinorPulse.
**Sounds/map-side (MapOnly defs played at pawn cell):** invest = Psycast_Skip_Entry whoosh (fallback Tick_High); mastery = PsycastPsychicEffect shimmer + Psycast_Skip_Pulse + FleckDefOf.PsycastAreaEffect (1.6x) at the pawn + keyed message PS_MsgSkillMastered (message ALWAYS sends, gated only by ShouldSendNotificationAbout); spec capstone = Psycast_Skip_Pulse; normal spec commits keep Quest_Accepted only.
**Setting:** skillFx (default ON, Skill leveling section, PS_SetSkillFx/Tip). OFF = no visuals (incl. mastered-tree glow), no extra sounds, legacy Tick_High restored; mastery message still sends. Enemy tier grants / dev tools / AwakeningTrigger never fire FX.

## Localization (2026-07-10): full keyed translation layer
Languages/English/Keyed/ holds 4 files (~480 keys), ALL user-facing C# strings route through .Translate(): **PS_Lore.xml** (tier names PS_Tier_Awakened/Enlightened/Illuminated + PS_TierTranscendent "Transcendent {0}"; every letter/message for awakening, enlightenment, transcendence, breakthroughs, comas, waves; card window titles/prompts/buttons; pending-pick alert; pilgrim inspect strings/float menus; ascension readout), **PS_UI.xml** (dialogs, tab tool block, focus gizmos, charges chip, spec window, skill tooltip incl. 14 PS_Stat_* labels + composition templates PS_PerLevel/PS_LvValue/PS_NowParen/PS_EachLevelPrimary etc., PsycastInfo PS_Fx* effect labels, 14 PS_Branch_* names, PS_MsgSkillMastered), **PS_Settings.xml** (5 PS_SetTab_* + every settings header/label/tooltip as PS_Set*/PS_Set*Tip incl. PS_SetSkillFx + PS_Ovr_* override notes + share/bake/discard flow), **PS_Specs.xml** (GENERATED from Specs.cs by regex: PS_Spec_<id> + PS_SpecDesc_<id> for all 58 nodes). **Mechanics:** Spec ctor + Specs.BranchLabel resolve via Specs.TranslateOr(key, fallback) = TryTranslate-with-fallback (missing keys keep authored English) — spec/branch keys are CONVENTION-based, so a new Spec added in code needs its PS_Spec_* keys regenerated (or relies on fallback). Everything else uses plain "PS_Key".Translate(args) — a missing key SHOWS as diacritic gibberish, so re-run the audit after adding strings: grep code keys vs XML keys with comm (see localization lore). EXCLUDED from keys (intentional): dev-mode tools (Window_BalanceEditor, debug actions, dev messages), generated HTML reports, Log.* lines. Def labels stay in Defs XML (DefInjected). TieringOverrideDef tierNames still beat PS_Tier_* translations. Dialog_Confirm's confirm label default is null -> PS_Confirm at runtime. **Edit user-facing strings in the XML, not in code.**

## Open-beta balance feedback: Share JSON export (2026-07-10)
Mod settings -> Specializations tab -> "Balance edits (open beta)": the PUBLIC button is now **"Share balance edits (export JSON)"** (PS_SetShare/N) -> `ManualBalance.ExportPlayerTuning`: writes the player's live PlayerTuning overlay (NOT merged with baked; pure export, nothing baked/cleared) to `<SaveData>/Psycasts2/BalanceIdeas_<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>.json`, GROUPED PER TREE: `{mod, exported, edits, trees:[{tree(defName), label, sourceMod(addon name), primaries:[{def,stat,statId,str}], empowerEdges:[{src,tgt,stat,statId,str}] (grouped under the TARGET's tree), sourceLists:[{def,sources}]}]}` — stat ints also emitted as SynStat names for readability. File path copied to clipboard; success dialog (PS_SetShareTitle/Body) tells the player to send the file to the author. **Bake into mod defaults is now DEV-MODE ONLY** (author flow, unchanged behavior: merges overlay into <modRoot>/ManualBalance.json, clears overlay); "Discard my balance edits" stays public. GOTCHA: GenFilePaths.FolderUnderSaveData is PRIVATE in 1.6 — use GenFilePaths.SaveDataFolderPath + Directory.CreateDirectory.

## No trait system
The enlightenment tier is the PS_Enlightenment hediff (Severity = tier, brain-seated). There is NO enlightenment trait - SetTier/TierOf are 100% hediff-based; Traits.xml is empty.

## Psycaster level cap is FLAT (default 400), tier-independent
vpeLevelCap default 400 (slider 30-500), overrideVpeLevelCap default true -> ApplyVpeLevelCap writes VPE maxLevel. Patch_LevelCap.EffectiveMax = BaseMax() (no tier). levelCapPerTier removed. Migration balanceVersion 4->5.

## Psylink gate + random Awakened spawn (Patch_EnemyTiers, GenerateNewPawnInternal, Priority.Last)
Postfix: TryInjectTier (hostile psycaster -> chance enemyTierFreq of a tier upgrade), then GatePsylink (when `gateUntieredPsylinks`, default ON): skip Awakened+/PS_AncientPsycasters; eligible humanlikes (13+) roll awakenedSpawnChance (0.05) to spawn as fresh Awakened (EnsurePsycaster + ApplyTier 70/22/8); otherwise generated psylinks are stripped. Tunable; 0% = none. `noAwakenedStartingPawns` (default ON) — pawns generated with PawnGenerationContext.PlayerStarter (new-game character creation) are exempt from the random Awakened+ roll, so starting colonists always begin mundane (any generated psylink still gets stripped by the gate); settings row indented under the spawn-chance slider, only shown while the gate is on. GrantPaths/GrantAscension are internal (reused by AwakeningTrigger.SilentGrant). All gates also respect TieringControl (EnemyTiersDisabled / PsylinkGateDisabled / RandomAwakenedSpawnsDisabled).

## XML Awakening Trigger API (AwakeningTrigger.cs + AwakeningSurfaces.cs + Defs/AwakeningTriggers.xml)
One shared `AwakeningTriggerExtension` DefModExtension vocabulary (tier/minAge/silent/letterLabel+Text with {PAWN}; one-shot: chance; persistent: chancePerDay, onlyWhileMeditating, scaleWithCertainty; surge: breakthroughMult; incident: incidentTarget=meditator|random) + one funnel `AwakeningTrigger.Fire(pawn, ext, source)` (public overload Fire(pawn, tier, silent) for C# mods). Eligibility: humanlike, alive, minAge (13), TierOf < tier — safe to re-apply. Player-faction pawns: med.awakened=true BEFORE EnsurePsycaster (blocks external-psylink double-fire), letter, OpenPick(tier) (card pick applies tier on embrace). Everyone else / silent: SilentGrant = EnsurePsycaster + SetTier (spec points only for player pawns) + ChangeLevel(+3/+4/+5 per tier gained = 3/7/12 cumulative parity with enemy tiers) + Patch_EnemyTiers.GrantPaths(delta) + full psyfocus + GrantAscension for non-player tier3+ when enemyAscension; letter for player pawns.
**7 surfaces:** (1) HediffComp_TriggerAwakening — fires once on CompPostPostAdd rolling `chance`, self-removes via CompShouldRemove (fired flag scribed); shipped hediffs PS_AwakeningTrigger / TierII / TierIII (parent PS_AwakeningTriggerBase; children override modExtensions with Inherit=False). (2) CompUseEffect_TriggerAwakening — usable artifacts; CanBeUsedBy refuses ineligible pawns; chance-miss shows a "psychic stirring" message. (3) IncidentWorker_TriggerAwakening + shipped PS_Awakening (baseChance 0, Map_PlayerHome) — targets deepest awakenMeditationTicks ("meditator") or "random". (4) GameCondition_AwakeningSurge + shipped PS_AwakeningSurge def (mult ×3, 25%/day meditators-only, canBePermanent) + inert wrapper incident PS_AwakeningSurgeIncident (1.5~3 days, baseChance 0); SurgeMult(map) multiplies BOTH RollHourly chances (inside the 0.6 caps) via GetAllGameConditionsAffectingMap (stacks multiplicatively). (5) ThoughtDef carrying the extension — hourly scan rolls PerHour(chancePerDay). (6) PreceptDef — believers roll; optional certainty scaling. (7) QuestNode_TriggerAwakening / QuestPart_TriggerAwakening — signal-driven; tier/silent/chance SlateRefs; full ExposeData + ReplacePawnReferences.
**Hooks:** MeditationSystem.Tick calls AwakeningTrigger.HourlyScan(gc) every 2500 ticks (independent of enlightenmentEnabled); scan covers map FreeColonistsSpawned + caravan/transporter free colonists (thought/precept only; surge is map-bound). Def caches built lazily on first scan. **Docs:** docs/wiki/xml-triggers.html.

## TieringOverrideDef — mod-facing ladder handoff (TieringOverride.cs)
Custom def type `<PsycastSynergies.TieringOverrideDef>`: disable flags (umbrella `disableBuiltInTiering`): disableMeditationAwakening, disableTranscendence, disablePilgrimages, disableExternalPsylinkAwakening, disableEnemyTiers, disableRandomAwakenedSpawns, disablePsylinkGate. Overrides beat player settings; affected settings rows show an amber ModOverrideNote naming the owning mod. **Reskin:** tierNames (consulted by EnlightenmentTier.Name → letters/health tab/cards/spec UI), tierNameBeyondFormat ({TIER}/{ROMAN}), tierSpecPoints. **TieringControl** static aggregator: disables OR-merge, first-wins reskins, OwnerLabel, startup log line. Trigger API deliberately ignores all disables. Awakening-meditation ticks still accrue while disabled. Wiki: section 8 on xml-triggers.html.

## ISEKAI RPG compat
suppressIsekaiPsycastStats (default ON): Patch_IsekaiSuppress strips IsekaiLeveling.* StatParts from psycaster stats at startup when JellyCreative.IsekaiLeveling is active.

## Awakening cards: manual flips, configurable deal, no-Esc + Choose later (2026-07-10)
`cardRevealAll` mode NO LONGER auto-flips the rest of the deck: after the first (committal-by-default) turn, remaining cards stay face-down and are turned BY HAND — click a centered face-down card to flip it (side cards scroll toward center first); any revealed card can be clicked to re-pick, and the centered-revealed card is the live selection (carousel-follow guarded by flipT>=0.999). Setting label is now "Turn all cards one at a time and re-pick" (PS_SetRevealAll). `cardPickCount` (slider 0-8, default 0): 0 = auto (3; Tier II deals 5), 1-8 = fixed deal for EVERY tier-up; consumed in MeditationSystem.ShowNextPick. Settings section "Awakening and cards" also carries a PS_SetChooseLaterInfo label documenting the Choose later flow.
**No-Esc + deferral safety net:** Window_Awakening sets `closeOnCancel = false` — Esc cannot dismiss the pick. The ONLY set-aside path is the "Choose later" button (bottom-right, always visible); it calls Close() without setting `resolved` (set by Confirm/ForgoForPoints/DeferReroll). PostClose without a decision requeues `med.pendingPick = tier` (scribed; the in-memory pickQueue is NOT) + caution message. Comas NO LONGER forfeit pendingPick. `Alert_PendingCardPick` (AlertPriority.High): culprits = map+caravan free colonists with pendingPick>0; CLICKING the alert consumes pendingPick and re-opens the pick immediately (falls back to jump-to-culprit when a pick window is already open). Meditation hourly roll remains the other re-open path.

## In-game synergy balance editor
**Access:** psycast tab, dev mode ON -> "Balance editor (dev)" row above the reset buttons (Patch_PsycastTabRespec). Window_BalanceEditor: THREE panes (rail / cards with dropdown chips for primary + "Gains power from" + "Empowers" / live preview with path art, node pips, source/empower highlighting, live values + scaling rates). Dev-only: NOT keyed for translation (intentional).
**Layering (PsycastInfo):** PlayerTuning (settings overlay) > ManualBalance.json (baked) > frozenSyn > computed. Only diffs stored; mutations clear caches; WriteSettings on close/reset.
**Storage:** tunePrimStat/tunePrimStr (defName), tuneEdgeStat/tuneEdgeStr ("src|tgt"), tuneSrcs (defName -> "A;B;C").
**Settings flow (Specializations tab -> "Balance edits (open beta)"):** PUBLIC = Share JSON export (see Open-beta section) + "Discard my balance edits"; DEV-MODE = Bake into <modRoot>/ManualBalance.json (merges overlay over baked records, player wins, clears overlay, reload).

## Psycast tab tool block + focus/path pickers (2026-07-10, replaces the pawn gizmos)
The per-pawn "Default focus" and "Pilgrim's Path" GIZMOS are REMOVED (Patch_PawnDefaultFocusGizmo now only yields the "Stop meditating" button; the building attunement gizmo is untouched). Their function moved into the psycast tab's bottom tool block (Patch_PsycastTabRespec), centered on the left pawn-info card: rows bottom-up = [Reset skills | Reset path], "Pilgrim's path: <Unbound/Trial of the Altar/Way of the Anima> ▾" dropdown (player faction + tier>=1), optional "Default focus ▾" fallback row, dev "Balance editor" row on top.
**Card-width anchoring (IMPORTANT):** Modern UI's left card is a FIXED 340px at x=14. `ModernUIBridge.LeftCardWidth(tabWidth)` = 340 when Wired else min(size.x*0.3, 340); used by BOTH the footer block AND Patch_SpecButtonInTab. The ★ spec button + tier numeral badge are right-aligned FLUSH to the card's own edge (3px inside the 2px border), NOT the 14px content edge.
**Focus picking via Modern Psycasts UI:** `ModernPsycastsUI.PawnFocusHooks` (public static Active/Get/Set delegates) wired by reflection at startup (ModernUIBridge.TryWire; no hard dependency either way): focus-type tiles become real buttons (click = set default focus, click selected = clear; unlock "+" keeps priority). Without the hooks the tab shows the "Default focus ▾" dropdown fallback.
**Modern Psycasts UI also fixed:** locked path tiles say just "Locked".

## Text conventions
"Respec" BANNED (it's "Reset"); "&" BANNED (use "and"); em/en dashes BANNED; sentence case with proper nouns kept (tier names, Enlightenment, Awakening, Tier I/II/III, path/spec names, Trial of the Altar, Way of the Anima, Ancient Psycaster Order, Apotheosis, Dignified, quoted VPE button "Upgrade Psycaster Stats" — string-matched by Patch_AutoStatsPerLevel, do NOT change, Mech-Mind). ALL user-facing text lives in Languages/English/Keyed/ — edit strings THERE.

## Unchanged
Brain hediffs; Apotheosis/Convergence/Illuminated/Singularity naming; dev tools (incl. Reset to non-psycaster); skills/synergies/specs/pilgrimages/ascensions.
